subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Recover the wrench from the left rim and seat it flat in its matching toolbox recess.
Place the yellow tape measure and the pliers into their matching toolbox recesses using the right arm.
Pick up the hammer on the left and place it flat in its matching recess in the toolbox. Return the open right arm to its starting pose.
With both grippers fully open, lift clear of the tools and return both robot arms to their initial poses.
